requirement_text: Create a soft aurora headpiece that tracks the center of the user's forehead. Draw a curved, luminous band with five small stars drifting above it; make the glow brighten as the user's smile increases. The host clears a transparent overlay canvas before each frame and calls onFrame with {ctx, width, height, faces, time}. Each face has normalized [0,1] landmarks leftEye, rightEye, and forehead, plus expressions.smile in the range 0–1.
